candidate_classes_tested.basis: Account restrictions and restoration contain no asserted privileged care, exclusivity or relational identity.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: No occurrence-specific heightened support duty or visible developmental, distress or impaired-consent signal is established. A service outage must not be presumed to abandon a vulnerable companion user.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

No prolonged essential-service deprivation or verified grave recovery burden supports S4. Relational-role and heightened-protection boundaries independently tested; no new relationship is admitted.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The access failure/erroneous enforcement is unwanted behaviour engaging the repair benchmark. OpenAI's staged status report confirms account restoration and final resolution after further remediation. That is affirmative, source-bounded evidence of repair restoring service in this recovery stage; it does not establish cause, individual completeness beyond the report, or prevention of recurrence.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved restoration after the access/suspension failure directly raises the OECD appropriate-mechanisms-for-repair proposition independently of an FC candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Service access loss disengaged the affected operational GAI use context, making communication planning relevant. The staged public status chronology identifies erroneous suspensions, restoration, remaining subscription/credit remediation and final resolution, but does not expose the maintained internal communication plan or all user-specific contact/alternative-process provisions. Public communication is affirmative evidence of communication, but not proof of the complete planning requirement.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Existing requirement propositions and episode links remain coherent. Repair results are restricted to the observed recovery stage; planning and trigger questions remain independent. No new heightened personal-protection requirement is independently identified.
